location: INT. HEART O' THE CITY HOTEL
summary: The Big Cop moves to cuff Trinity, but she reacts with inhuman speed, striking him in the nose and kicking him into another officer. As the remaining cops fire their weapons and panic, Trinity snatches a gun from a fallen officer, fires it, and engages in a final exchange of gunfire. When the shooting stops, she is the only one standing, and she says, 'Shit.'

what_changes.before: Under arrest, hands behind head, being cuffed
what_changes.after: Free, standing alone among the dead cops
Kicked backward, slamming into another cop

event_hint.one_line: Trinity kills the police officers who arrested her.
